preconditions.description: Attacker must hold at least 1 JizzJet token to initiate transfer

violation_target.exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the _getCurrentSupply() function where integer overflow can occur when subtracting excluded account balances. Attack by: 1) Get excluded from fees via owner (or exploit if owner is compromised), 2) Transfer tokens to create large rOwned values for excluded accounts, 3) Trigger swapAndLiquify via transfer when contract balance exceeds threshold, 4) The overflow in _getCurrentSupply() will cause incorrect rate calculation, allowing attacker to receive excessive BNB from swap. Key functions: transfer() to trigger swapAndLiquify, _getCurrentSupply() has the overflow.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is in the _getCurrentSupply() function. When calculating rSupply and tSupply, it subtracts _rOwned and _tOwned of excluded accounts. If any excluded account has _rOwned > rSupply, the function returns (_rTotal, _tTotal) instead of continuing. This can cause the rate calculation to be artificially inflated when swapAndLiquify is triggered, as the rate = rSupply / tSupply would use initial totals instead of actual reduced supply. An attacker who is excluded from rewards can manipulate _rOwned values to trigger this condition.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate owner to exclude attacker from rewards and fees. 2. Acquire tokens and transfer to excluded accounts (like contract itself) to inflate their _rOwned values. 3. Make contract token balance exceed numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity threshold. 4. Trigger swapAndLiquify via a transfer. 5. The swap will use inflated rate, causing economic imbalance where attacker can profit.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate owner. 2. Call excludeFromReward(attacker) and excludeFromFee(attacker). 3. Get initial tokens from owner via transfer. 4. Ensure contract address is excluded from rewards. 5. Transfer large amount to contract to inflate its _rOwned. 6. Top up contract balance to reach swap threshold. 7. Trigger swap by transferring tokens (not from pair). 8. Profit from rate manipulation during swap.
